content: Do I need to lift heavy to build muscle?

No, you don't have to lift heavy. Research shows muscle growth is similar across a wide range of loads, roughly 5 to 30 reps per set, as long as the sets are taken close to failure (about 0-3 reps left). Heavier loads in the 5-10 rep range are more time-efficient. Lighter sets need more reps and tolerate more fatigue.

💡 For your 100 kg bench goal, heavy work still matters. Strength is specific, so you need to practice lifting heavy weights on the bench. A good mix is heavy sets of 3-6 reps on the main lifts, with 8-15 rep sets for accessories.
